```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class BookmarksTable extends Component
{
    public function render()
    {
        $bookmarks = Auth::user()->bookmarks;

        return view('livewire.bookmarks-table', compact('bookmarks'));
    }

    public function store($bookmark)
    {
        // Logic to store the bookmark
        auth()->user()->bookmarks()->create(['url' => $bookmark]);
        $this->dispatch('store-bookmark');
    }

    public function delete($bookmarkId)
    {
        // Logic to delete the bookmark by ID
        auth()->user()->bookmarks()->find($bookmarkId)->delete();
        $this->dispatch('delete-bookmark', ['id' => $bookmarkId]);
    }
}
```
